items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And I was playing with Bill Coleman and I'd make that trip almost every week from Paris.

ctx.x: Willie Smith. So the first one to be cross-Country was only three horns. That was Lester and Coleman Hawkins and myself and Helen

Humes, Kenny Kersey on piano. And we came all the way from Los Angeles to New York. That was the end of it. Then later, he started adding on. He added on the Illinois Jacquet. He added on Rex Stewart, Trummy Young, Roy Eldridge, Coleman. And it ended up being a great big show. But at least we made the first cross, cross Country one.
When I first heard you after the War it seemed to me that you were playing with much more power and range than you did before the War.
